GPUはまだ本気出してなかった、という話を追加 Inkling2-miniを16万円で買った非NVIDIA GPUで150tok/s(通常デコードタスク)まで持っていった / MacStudio 512GBがAI用途に不向きな理由/そして今買うべきなのは・・・｜shi3z @shi3z note.com/shi3zblog/n/n1abc37…

A verifying, self-correcting agent harness with a live web console for local LLM engines (developed against Inkling-2-Mini on llama-server, any OpenAI-compatible server with tool calling should work).

The model writes commands, the harness runs them, feeds the result back, and a second supervisor agent (separate context) watches and steers. You watch and drive everything from a browser: streaming thinking, answer text, commands, live command output, generated images/videos, and the servers the agent started.

I just ported StreamDiffusion to Mac!

Up to 19 FPS at 256×256 resolution on an Apple M2 Max. Real-time image generation on Apple Silicon. No NVIDIA GPU, no CUDA required!

#StreamDiffusion #AppleSilicon #GenerativeAI #LocalAI
